title: Forme Decision Card
description: One proposal for the user to accept / park / reject. Envelope-shaped (origin/from/role) so a card can later be relayed between Forme nodes. Produced by a read-only agent; written to disk deterministically by Forme code.

schemaVersion.description: Card schema major version. Bumped on breaking changes.

id.description: Unique id of this card instance (not stable across regenerations; see fingerprint for identity).

origin.description: Envelope: the substrate + agent run that produced the content.

model.description: Optional model identifier used for the run.

runId.description: Runner invocation id that produced this card.

from.description: Envelope: identity of the Forme node that emitted this card. Reserved for post-MVP agent relay; MVP is always the local node.

role.description: Envelope: message role in the relay protocol. v0 cards are always 'proposal'. Reserved future values: 'digest' (State Diff), 'decision', 'relay', 'ack'.

category.description: Drift category slug. Part of the dedup fingerprint. kebab-case, e.g. 'stale-frontmatter', 'broken-link', 'stale-claim', 'orphan'.

title.description: Human headline of the card (Chinese by default). The one thing the user reads first.

summary.description: Optional single-line context beneath the title.

evidence.description: Why this card exists. Every claim in the title must be grounded here. Rendered as the 证据 block.

diff.description: The single minimal change proposed. Applied deterministically by Forme code (git-committed for rollback), and rendered as -/+.

options.description: Decision gestures. MVP is always accept / park / reject.

fingerprint.description: Deterministic dedup key = sha256(category \u0000 diff.file \u0000 diffHash). Computed by Forme code, not the agent. A fingerprint on the rejected/parked list is dropped before presentation (hard constraint #6).

whyNow.description: Card face v0.1 (#12): why this card exists now (出身/时机) — the legibility answer, one plain-language line, rendered as 为什么现在.

recommendation.description: Card face v0.1 (#12): the agent's declared recommendation — first form of shadow mode. Compared against the actual choice for the W5 consistency metric; never auto-applied.

onAccept.description: Card face v0.1 (#12): one plain-language line previewing what happens after accept. The deterministic facts (target file, rollback) are appended by the renderer.

estSeconds.description: Agent's estimate of time-to-decision in seconds. Informational; real latency is measured silently.

createdAt.description: When Forme wrote this card to disk.

path.description: Vault-relative path of the evidence source.

locator.description: Optional pointer within the file, e.g. 'L283', 'frontmatter.status', '#anchor'.

note.description: Agent's one-line reason this is evidence.

file.description: Vault-relative path of the file the change targets. Part of the fingerprint.

hunk.description: An exact-string replacement: match `before` in the file, replace with `after`. before='' is a pure insertion; after='' is a deletion. Deterministic to apply and to render as -/+.

locator.description: Optional anchor to disambiguate which occurrence to change, e.g. a line number or field name.

before.description: Exact text to match. '' means insert.
